articles.headline: Courtois backs underdog Belgium to upset Spain in World Cup quarterfinals
articles.description: Belgium goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois is looking forward to facing Spain for the first time in his career in an official match during Friday's World Cup quarterfinal at SoFi Stadium.

articles.headline: Didier Deschamps unconcerned by Argentine officials in France-Morocco World Cup clash
articles.description: France head coach Didier Deschamps has played down the appointment of Argentinian officials for their World Cup quarterfinal against Morocco on Thursday.

articles.headline: Morocco star Saibari to miss World Cup quarterfinal vs. France
articles.description: Morocco will be without star forward Ismael Saibari for their World Cup quarterfinal with France on Thursday.
